title.value: Gradient Descent Is Optimal Under Lower Restricted Secant Inequality And Upper Error Bound
title.justification: The title clearly reflects the main focus of the paper, which is about the optimality of Gradient Descent under certain mathematical conditions.
title.quote: Gradient Descent Is Optimal Under Lower Restricted Secant Inequality And Upper Error Bound

extractions.description: This paper analyzes the optimality of the Gradient Descent method under specific mathematical conditions—Lower Restricted Secant Inequality (RSI) and Upper Error Bound (EB). It suggests that standard assumptions like strong convexity and smoothness may be flawed, proposing these alternative conditions as more robust. The key finding is that Gradient Descent is exactly optimal for these classes of objective functions, implying no accelerated algorithm can offer improvements without additional assumptions. This work is primarily theoretical and focuses on providing precise conditions and proofs.

It doesn't address any specific climate or ecological sustainable development goals.
